resources.string: Drop here to close the bubble
Data: Moonton via Rone Arena (arena.rone.dev). Unofficial.
Show the counter bubble over your game?

To float the counter bubble over Mobile Legends, this app needs the "Display over other apps" permission.

On the next screen, find Ace Counter Pick near the top of the list, tap it and turn the switch on. Then press Back and the bubble will appear.

The app does not read your screen or game. It only shows hero tips you tap on.
Ace Counter Pick needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission to float over your game.

Tap the bubble for counters. Drag it to the X to close.
